Write access to any smaller unit of memory is only possible on read-modify-write basis, this action results in
higher stress to the memory hardware. The STM32H5 series, STM32C5 series, STM32U5 series, and
STM32H7Ax/Bx line also feature added robustness on the small 0.5-2 Kbyte OTP area, where every 16 bits are
protected with 6 bits of ECC redundancy. There is no OTP memory area on STM32H72x/3x/4x/5x lines.

document: AN5342 - Table 6. Methods for ECC testing in nonvolatile memory
title: Table 6. Methods for ECC testing in nonvolatile memory
text_helper: Table 6. Methods for ECC testing in nonvolatile memory — section 3.2 ECC testing in nonvolatile memory. Method, Advantages, Disadvantages, Applicable products.

rows: Dedicated flash word with errors planted from factory
• Simple to use, only requires read from the dedicated address to get the ECC interrupt • Simple section of SEC or DED outcome
• Address decoding test is not possible • Feature is only available in selected series
Data programmed to a location that was not erased before
• Can be applied anywhere in nonvolatile memory • Known patterns to select SEC or DED outcome
• Feature is only available in selected series
STM32C5 series STM32H5 series STM32H7 series
Disturbing the flash erase or program cycle with a reset
• Universally applicable • Can be applied anywhere in memory
• Tuning is required to provide the correctly timed reset • Achieving SEC is difficult
Aimed at testing data area ECC protection
• Limited to the last few sectors of nonvolatile memory • Not usable once the option bytes are closed • Achieving SEC is difficult
